column3: prompt (the STYLE suffix in generate.sh is appended automatically)

a cramped hacker lair inside an old concrete building at night, a sleek unbadged futuristic superbike with a matte black fairing parked in the center, its bodywork traced by thin glowing neon edge-light lines, walls of salvaged monitors and tangled cables on both sides, rain streaking a tall window behind with a blurred megacity of holographic light, glowing grid lines on the wet concrete floor reflecting everything, dark calm space in the upper half of the frame

a towering archive of old books inside a derelict server vault, the book spines dissolving into streams of glowing data threads that pour into a single floating holographic node above a scarred metal desk, iridescent prismatic light, cables hanging from the ceiling

a holographic orrery made of glowing neon rings and small light orbs floating above a matte black machined aluminum console, the planet orbits drawn as thin lines of light, an iridescent psychedelic star field reflected in the polished surface

raw copper ore and dark tin ore rocks on a matte black industrial surface, being scanned by thin glowing laser grid lines, metallic flecks sparkling, faint holographic measurement rings around the rocks with no numbers, rocks toward the right side, dark wide composition

top-down view of a cluttered hacker workbench at night, a disassembled mechanical keyboard, a soldering iron with a thin curl of smoke, bare circuit boards, a tablet showing an abstract glowing wireframe with no readable text, unlabeled cans, tangled cables, every object outlined by neon edge light

a glowing wireframe structure built from neon light lines rising out of a matte black grid floor like a digital city block under construction, light trails racing along the grid, deep one-point perspective

macro photograph of a bundle of fiber optic strands bursting outward, the tips glowing amber and magenta with iridescent psychedelic color shifts along the strands, slight chromatic aberration, deep dark background

two light trails, one amber and one cyan, racing toward each other across a black mirrored grid plain at night and crossing in the center in a burst of prismatic light, long exposure motion streaks, horizon glowing faintly violet

a lived-in cyberpunk studio corner at night, a worn leather chair patched with tape, shelves of salvaged electronics and old books, a motorcycle helmet with a mirrored visor resting on the shelf, thin neon edge lights along the shelves, rain on the window with a blurred neon city beyond

an old CRT monitor retrofitted with exposed wiring and a glowing neon strip, seen from the side so the screen cannot be read, on a cramped desk with a coffee mug, a rain-streaked window behind with blurred magenta and cyan city lights
